verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ miz·mō·wr Yah·weh ḥă·qar·ta·nî wat·tê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David O LORD You have searched me and known me
verses.literalPt: Jeová, tu me sondas e conheces.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā šiḇ·tî wə·qū·mî ban·tāh lə·rê·‘î mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: You know when I sit and when I rise You understand my thoughts from afar
verses.literalPt: Tu conheces o meu sentar e o meu levantar; de longe, entendes o meu pensamento.

verses.original: אָרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכָל־ דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rə·ḥî wə·riḇ·‘î zê·rî·ṯā wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵay his·kan·tāh
verses.literal: You search out my path and my lying down You are aware of all my ways
verses.literalPt: Esquadrinhas a minha vereda e o meu pouso; estás ciente de todos os meus caminhos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên mil·lāh bil·šō·w·nî hên Yah·weh yā·ḏa‘·tā ḵul·lāh
verses.literal: Even . . . before a word is on my tongue . . . You know all about it O LORD
verses.literalPt: Pois ainda a palavra não está na minha língua, já tu, Jeová, a conheces toda.

verses.original: אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥō·wr wā·qe·ḏem ṣar·tā·nî wat·tā·šeṯ ‘ā·lay kap·pe·ḵāh
verses.literal: You hem me in behind and before You have laid Your hand upon me
verses.literalPt: Por detrás e por diante, me cercas e pões sobre mim a tua mão.

verses.original: פִּלְאִיָּה דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־ א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: pil·ʾī·yå̄h ḏa·‘aṯ mim·men·nî niś·gə·ḇāh lō- ’ū·ḵal lāh
verses.literal: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me too lofty for me to attain
verses.literalPt: Tal conhecimento é maravilhoso demais para mim; elevado é, não o posso atingir.

verses.original: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nāh ’ê·lêḵ mê·rū·ḥe·ḵā wə·’ā·nāh mip·pā·ne·ḵā ’eḇ·rāḥ
verses.literal: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit Where can I flee from Your presence
verses.literalPt: Para onde me irei do teu Espírito? Ou para onde fugirei da tua presença?

verses.original: אִם־ אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’es·saq šā·ma·yim šām ’āt·tāh wə·’aṣ·ṣî·‘āh šə·’ō·wl hin·ne·kā
verses.literal: If I ascend to the heavens You are there if I make my bed in Sheol You are there
verses.literalPt: Se eu subir aos céus, lá tu estás; se eu fizer a minha cama no Sheol, eis que estás ali.

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־ שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eś·śā ḵan·p̄ê- šā·ḥar ’eš·kə·nāh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ yām
verses.literal: If I rise on the wings of the dawn if I settle by the farthest sea
verses.literalPt: Se eu tomar as asas da alva, e habitar nas extremidades do mar,

verses.original: גַּם־ שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ga·mō·šā- šām yā·ḏə·ḵā ṯan·ḥê·nî wə·ṯō·ḥă·zê·nî yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: even there Your hand will guide me Your right hand will hold me fast
verses.literalPt: ainda lá me guiará a tua mão, e me susterá a tua destra.

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’aḵ- ḥō·šeḵ yə·šū·p̄ê·nî wə·lay·lāh ’ō·wr ba·‘ă·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: If I say Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me
verses.literalPt: Se eu disser: Certamente, as trevas me encobrirão, e a luz ao redor de mim se tornará noite;

verses.original: גַּם־ חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־ יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ḥō·šeḵ lō- yaḥ·šîḵ mim·me·ḵā wə·lay·lāh kay·yō·wm yā·’îr ka·ḥă·šê·ḵāh kā·’ō·w·rāh
verses.literal: even the darkness is not dark to You but the night shines like the day for darkness is as light to You
verses.literalPt: até as trevas não são demasiado escuras para ti, mas a noite resplandece como o dia. Para ti, tanto fazem as trevas como a luz.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh qā·nî·ṯā ḵil·yō·ṯāy tə·suk·kê·nî bə·ḇe·ṭen ’im·mî
verses.literal: For You formed my inmost being You knit me together in my mother’s womb
verses.literalPt: Pois tu formaste os meus rins, entrelaçaste-me no ventre de minha mãe.

verses.original: אֽוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā ‘al kî nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ nip̄·lê·ṯî nip̄·lā·’îm ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā wə·nap̄·šî yō·ḏa·‘aṯ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: I praise You for I am fearfully and wonderfully made Marvelous are Your works and I know this very well
verses.literalPt: Graças te darei, pois sou assombrosa e maravilhosamente feito. Maravilhosas são as tuas obras, e a minha alma o sabe muito bem.

verses.original: לֹא־ נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־ עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- niḵ·ḥaḏ ‘ā·ṣə·mî mim·me·kā ’ă·šer- ‘uś·śê·ṯî ḇas·sê·ṯer ruq·qam·tî bə·ṯaḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret when I was woven together in the depths of the earth
verses.literalPt: Não te era oculta a minha forma, quando fui feito às ocultas e primorosamente tecido nas profundezas da terra.

verses.original: גָּלְמִ֤י׀ רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־ סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ וְלֹא אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gā·lə·mî rā·’ū ‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·‘al- sip̄·rə·ḵā kul·lām yik·kā·ṯê·ḇū yā·mîm yuṣ·ṣā·rū wə·lō ’e·ḥāḏ bā·hem
verses.literal: Your eyes saw my unformed body all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me . . . before one of them came to be
verses.literalPt: Os teus olhos viram a minha substância ainda informe; e no teu livro, foram escritos os dias, todos os dias que foram ordenados, quando nenhum deles ainda existia.

verses.original: וְלִ֗י מַה־ יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lî mah- yā·qə·rū rê·‘e·ḵā ’êl meh ‘ā·ṣə·mū rā·šê·hem
verses.literal: How precious to me are Your thoughts O God how vast is their sum
verses.literalPt: Para mim, quão preciosos são os teus pensamentos, ó Jeová! Quão grande é a soma deles!

verses.original: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’es·pə·rêm mê·ḥō·wl yir·būn hĕ·qî·ṣō·ṯî wə·‘ō·w·ḏî ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: If I were to count them they would outnumber the grains of sand and when I awake I am still with You
verses.literalPt: Se eu os contasse, são eles mais numerosos do que a areia. Quando acordo, ainda estou contigo.

verses.original: אִם־ תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ׀ רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tiq·ṭōl ’ĕ·lō·w·ah rā·šā‘ wə·’an·šê ḏā·mîm sū·rū men·nî
verses.literal: O God that You would slay the wicked away from me you bloodthirsty men
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que tirasses a vida ao perverso, ó Deus. Apartai-vos de mim, homens sanguinários.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשֻׂ֖א לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yō·mə·ru·ḵā lim·zim·māh nā·śu laš·šāw ‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: who speak of You deceitfully Your enemies take Your name in vain
verses.literalPt: Eles se rebelam malvadamente contra ti, e os teus inimigos tomam em vão o teu nome.

verses.original: הֲלֽוֹא־ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- mə·śan·’e·ḵā Yah·weh ’eś·nā ū·ḇiṯ·qō·wm·me·ḵā ’eṯ·qō·w·ṭāṭ
verses.literal: Do I not hate those who hate You O LORD and detest those who rise against You
verses.literalPt: Não aborreço eu, Jeová, os que te aborrecem? Não abomino eu os que se levantam contra ti?

verses.original: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: taḵ·lîṯ śin·’āh śə·nê·ṯîm lə·’ō·wy·ḇîm hā·yū lî
verses.literal: I hate them with perfect hatred I count them as my enemies
verses.literalPt: Aborreço-os com ódio completo; eles se tornaram os meus inimigos.

verses.original: חָקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·qə·rê·nî ’êl wə·ḏa‘ lə·ḇā·ḇî bə·ḥā·nê·nî wə·ḏa‘ śar·‘ap·pāy
verses.literal: Search me O God and know my heart test me and know my concerns
verses.literalPt: Sonda-me, ó Deus, e conhece o meu coração; prova-me e conhece os meus pensamentos;

verses.original: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’êh ’im- de·reḵ- ‘ō·ṣeḇ bî ū·nə·ḥê·nî bə·ḏe·reḵ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: See if there is any offensive way in me lead me in the way everlasting
verses.literalPt: vê se em mim há algum caminho de perversidade e guia-me pelo caminho eterno.
